explanation: In the UAE, business meetings often start a few minutes late due to a relaxed attitude toward punctuality, especially in more traditional or family-run firms. However, foreign-owned or multinational companies typically expect punctuality, and arriving more than 10-15 minutes late without a valid excuse can be seen as disrespectful. The practice varies widely based on the company culture and the Emirati versus expatriate composition of the team.
local_tip: Always call or message ahead if you will be more than 10 minutes late, and apologize briefly upon arrival.
regional_note: In Dubai's fast-paced business environment, punctuality is more strictly observed than in Abu Dhabi or smaller emirates, where a looser approach may prevail.

also_check.note: Punctuality is critical; arriving even one minute late is considered disrespectful.
Germans value strict punctuality; lateness is seen as unprofessional and inconsiderate.
In Brazil, arriving 15-30 minutes late to business meetings is common and often expected.
